about_the_game:
Build your own Axion shop, collect rare parts, create powerful combinations, and battle your way to becoming a Pro Axioner! My Axion Shop offers a unique gaming experience blending strategy, trading, and collection elements.

Choose your destiny — or master both:

  • Rise as a Pro Axioner:
    Collect Axion Points, battle your way from amateur to Legend Rank, and build your reputation across the streets and tournaments.

  • Grow Your Axion Shop:
    Customize your store, attract more customers, unlock new parts, and become the go-to place for elite Axioners.

Your journey is yours to shape. Fight for glory, build for legacy — or do both.

MANAGE YOUR SHOP

  • Establish and expand your own Axion shop

  • Master the market economy by buying and selling parts

  • Keep your customers satisfied and build your shop's reputation

  • Discover rare pieces and grow your business with strategic decisions

BATTLES & TOURNAMENTS

  • Challenge rivals with your carefully assembled Axion combinations

  • Gain Axion Points and grow your reputation through dynamic street battles

  • Participate in tournaments to win valuable rewards and exclusive parts

  • Develop unique battle strategies based on Axion types, synergy, and timing

You Don’t Just Control Your Axion — You Become One With It
This isn’t just a battle — it’s a test of instinct, reflex, and synergy.

With your keyboard or gamepad, take full real-time control: launch, dodge, strike, and dominate.

COMBINE AXION PARTS

  • Create your unique Axions from various components like Crest, Power Ring, Impact Disk, Core, Stabilizer, and Tip

  • Find your perfect strategy by balancing stats such as Attack, Defense, and Stamina

  • Craft diverse strategies with different Axion types: Attack, Defense, Balance, and Stamina

EXPAND YOUR COLLECTION

  • Collect parts in five different rarity levels from Common to Legendary

  • Discover special and rare components

  • Compete with others for the most valuable parts

FEATURES

  • Deep Shop Management: Run and develop your own Axion shop

  • Strategic Battle System: Defeat rivals using part combinations and stat balance

  • Rich Collection System: Gather hundreds of parts across different rarity levels

  • Exciting Tournaments: Test your skills in special tournaments

  • Dual Progression Paths: Climb the ranks as a Pro Axioner while expanding your custom shop business
